description: Position (km, ICRF/J2000 equatorial axes) and velocity (km/s) of an object at a date, relative to a centre (default: the body it orbits or stands on), with distance, altitude above the centre, speed, light time, whether it is in sunlight, and provenance. Around the Earth, the Moon or Mars it also gives the ground point below it (latitude, longitude; on the Earth the country or sea, e.g. "over Brazil", "over the Indian Ocean").

id.description: Object id from perigee_find (NORAD number, mission id, planet, "moon:<id>", "site:<id>", "launch:<id>", "star:<id>", "comet:<id>", "asteroid:<id>" or a dwarf planet name), e.g. "25544" for the ISS.

name: perigee_state
title: Position and velocity
